minutes.headline: Planning Board heard the school campus site plan, shelved a letter on the 120-unit Lunenburg Village, signed 50 Elmwood Road
minutes.summary: The board heard an overview of the site plan for the new combined high school and middle school, to return June 9th. It approved three sets of minutes and signed findings and directives for 50 Elmwood Road after a resident questioned the sidewalk waiver. It discussed the Village District bylaw and building reuse, and a motion to send the zoning appeals board a letter on the 120-unit project was withdrawn. It also reviewed the housing production plan scope.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted to accept the findings and directives for 50 Elmwood Road, after a resident questioned how the sidewalk waiver was documented.
A motion to send the zoning board of appeals a letter on the 120-unit Lunenburg Village project was withdrawn; the vote was not audible.
The board heard an overview of the site plan for the new combined high school and middle school, and continued the hearing to June 9th.
The board discussed the Village District bylaw and building reuse, and Marjerie is to schedule a joint workshop with the building reuse committee.
The board reviewed the housing production plan scope, with separate contracts for the plan and housing element funded from technical assistance money.

why_it_matters: The school campus site plan will shape traffic, lighting and road access around the new building, and the hearing is still open for residents to speak.

The 120-unit project went to no letter from the board, so any planning-board view on it will have to come another way, and the Village District bylaw and building reuse could change how the town centre is used and what the six buildings cost the town budget, mostly taxes.
watch_next: June 9th: the continued hearing on the school campus site plan, time to be set.
A joint workshop between the Planning Board and the building reuse committee, to be scheduled.
